entities.name: Post-Clontarf Gaelic Ireland
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Rival provincial kings (O'Briens, O'Connors, MacMurroughs) vied for the High Kingship. Church reform under the Synod of Cashel (1101) and Synod of Kells (1152) aligned Irish Christianity with Rome. Diarmait MacMurrough's fateful invitation to the Normans.
